paragraphs: R’ Yonatan (the colleague of R’ Evyatar).

Hyman describes him as R’ Yochanan’s student, reporting in his name in [Bereshit Rabbah 64:4](https://www.sefaria.org/Bereshit_Rabbah.64.4). In Hyman’s account, cited as Gittin 36a (compare [Gittin 37a](https://www.sefaria.org/Gittin.37a.6)), R’ Yochanan entrusts the matter to R’ Chiyya bar Abba, followed by a question whether anything further is needed and the reply, “You need nothing further.” In [Gittin 6b](https://www.sefaria.org/Gittin.6b.6), R’ Evyatar sends a message to Rav Chisda. Later in the passage, R’ Evyatar says that he found a fly with her, and R’ Yonatan says that he found a hair. R’ Evyatar meets Elijah and asks what the Holy One, blessed be He, is doing. Elijah replies, “My son Evyatar says this; My son Yonatan says that,” etc. [Bereshit Rabbah 9:5](https://www.sefaria.org/Bereshit_Rabbah.9.5) mentions R’ Chiyya, the son of R’ Berekhiah’s daughter, and R’ Yonatan replies to him, etc.[^1]

notes.text: [Hyman, vol. II, p. 700](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/6/60/Aaron_Hyman._Toldoth_Tannaim_veAmoraim._II._1910.pdf#page=283) gives 36a and names Yochanan. In the consulted Gittin 37a, Yonatan gives instructions to Chiyya bar Abba, asks whether anything else is needed, and is told it is unnecessary. [Rashba](https://www.sefaria.org/Rashba_on_Gittin.37a.3) likewise names Yonatan and discusses whether a written declaration was needed. See [Gittin 6b](https://www.sefaria.org/Gittin.6b.11-13) for the fly, hair and Elijah exchange. At Bereshit Rabbah 9:5, the Davidson translation takes Yonatan’s reply as addressed to Rabbi Chama bar Chanina. [Seder HaDorot](https://www.girsology.com/seder-hadorot.html?entry=1878&lang=en) likewise links Yonatan and Evyatar.
